metadata.description: Role-based Claude skill packs for engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, design, marketing, SEO, QA and security teams.

plugins.name: anthropica
plugins.description: Every Anthropica skill and specialist agent in one plugin.

plugins.name: anthropica-devops
plugins.description: GitHub commits, PRs, Actions and governance, CI/CD, releases, containers, observability and incident response.

plugins.name: anthropica-infrastructure
plugins.description: Infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, observability, incident response, architecture and GitHub workflow standards.

plugins.name: anthropica-engineering
plugins.description: Codebase analysis, backend, frontend, database, testing and GitHub workflow standards.

plugins.name: anthropica-design
plugins.description: UI/UX and accessibility reviews, design systems and design-to-code handoff.

plugins.name: anthropica-marketing
plugins.description: On-brand marketing copy, campaign planning and measurement, and search-friendly content.

plugins.name: anthropica-seo
plugins.description: Technical SEO audits, content briefs and on-page optimisation, and Core Web Vitals investigation.

plugins.name: anthropica-qa
plugins.description: Risk-based test plans, test cases, bug reports, automated testing and release readiness.

plugins.name: anthropica-security
plugins.description: Security reviews, threat modeling, supply-chain security, repository governance and incident response.
